title: RAVENEA: A Benchmark for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Visual Culture Understanding

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on culture-focused visual question answering (cVQA) and culture-informed image captioning (cIC) tasks across image datasets representing eight different countries. The study measures cross-cultural performance disparities and regional preferences using accuracy metrics and a novel 'RegionScore' to quantify cultural and geographic grounding.
